source.text: וַיַּקְהֵ֣ל דָּוִ֣יד אֶת־כָּל־שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל שָׂרֵ֣י הַשְּׁבָטִ֣ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמַּחְלְק֣וֹת הַמְשָׁרְתִ֪ים אֶת־הַמֶּ֟לֶךְ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָאֲלָפִ֣ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֡וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י כָל־רְכוּשׁ־וּמִקְנֶה֩׀לַמֶּ֨לֶךְ וּלְבָנָ֜יו עִם־הַסָּרִיסִ֧ים וְהַגִּבּוֹרִ֛ים וּֽלְכָל־גִּבּ֥וֹר חָ֖יִל אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And assembled David all [the] officials of Israel, [the] officials of the tribes and [the] officials of the divisions serving the king, and [the] officials of the thousands and [the] officials of the hundreds, and [the] officials of all [the] property and livestock of the king and of his sons, with the eunuchs and the mighty men and every mighty man of valor, to Jerusalem.

en.L: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the commanders of the divisions who served the king, and the commanders of the thousands and the commanders of the hundreds, and the princes over all the property and livestock of the king and of his sons, together with the eunuchs and the mighty men and every mighty man of valor, to Jerusalem.
en.B: David gathered all the officials of Israel at Jerusalem: the officials of the tribes, the commanders of the divisions that served the king, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, and the officials who managed all the property and livestock that belonged to the king and his sons, along with the court officials, the warriors and every mighty warrior.
en.R: David called all the leaders of Israel to come to Jerusalem. They included the leaders of the tribes, the commanders of the army divisions that served the king, the commanders of units of a thousand and of a hundred men, and the leaders who looked after all the land and herds of the king and his sons. The palace officials, the famous fighters and all the other brave warriors came too.

es.L: Y reunió David a todos los príncipes de Israel, los príncipes de las tribus, y los jefes de las divisiones que servían al rey, y los jefes de millares y los jefes de centenas, y los príncipes sobre toda la hacienda y el ganado del rey y de sus hijos, con los eunucos y los valientes y todo hombre valiente y esforzado, en Jerusalén.
es.B: David reunió en Jerusalén a todos los jefes de Israel: los jefes de las tribus, los comandantes de las divisiones que servían al rey, los jefes de millares y los jefes de centenas, y los encargados de toda la hacienda y el ganado del rey y de sus hijos, junto con los funcionarios de la corte, los guerreros y todo guerrero valiente.
es.R: David mandó llamar a Jerusalén a todos los líderes de Israel. Entre ellos estaban los líderes de las tribus, los comandantes de las divisiones del ejército que servían al rey, los comandantes de unidades de mil y de cien hombres, y los encargados de todas las tierras y el ganado del rey y de sus hijos. También vinieron los funcionarios del palacio, los guerreros famosos y todos los demás guerreros valientes.

fr.L: Et David rassembla à Jérusalem tous les princes d’Israël, les princes des tribus, et les chefs des classes qui servaient le roi, et les chefs de milliers, et les chefs de centaines, et les intendants de tous les biens et du bétail du roi et de ses fils, avec les eunuques, et les vaillants hommes, et tout vaillant guerrier.
fr.B: David réunit à Jérusalem tous les dignitaires d’Israël : les chefs des tribus, les chefs des classes qui servaient le roi, les chefs de milliers et les chefs de centaines, les intendants de tous les biens et de tous les troupeaux du roi et de ses fils, ainsi que les hauts fonctionnaires, les guerriers et tous les vaillants combattants.
fr.R: David a convoqué à Jérusalem tous les chefs d’Israël. Il y avait les chefs des tribus, les chefs des divisions de l’armée qui servaient le roi, les officiers qui commandaient mille hommes ou cent hommes, et les responsables de toutes les terres et de tous les troupeaux du roi et de ses fils. Les fonctionnaires du palais, les guerriers célèbres et tous les autres combattants courageux sont venus aussi.

sw.L: Daudi akawakusanya wakuu wote wa Israeli, wakuu wa makabila, na makamanda wa zamu waliomtumikia mfalme, na makamanda wa maelfu na makamanda wa mamia, na wakuu juu ya mali yote na mifugo ya mfalme na ya wanawe, pamoja na matowashi na mashujaa na kila shujaa hodari, huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Daudi aliwakusanya maafisa wote wa Israeli huko Yerusalemu: maafisa wa makabila, makamanda wa zamu zilizomtumikia mfalme, makamanda wa maelfu na makamanda wa mamia, na maafisa waliosimamia mali yote na mifugo iliyokuwa ya mfalme na wanawe, pamoja na maafisa wa ikulu, mashujaa na kila shujaa hodari.
sw.R: Daudi aliwaita viongozi wote wa Israeli waje Yerusalemu. Miongoni mwao walikuwa viongozi wa makabila, makamanda wa zamu za jeshi zilizomtumikia mfalme, makamanda wa vikosi vya watu elfu na vya watu mia, na viongozi waliotunza ardhi yote na mifugo ya mfalme na wanawe. Maafisa wa ikulu, wapiganaji maarufu na wapiganaji wengine wote jasiri nao walikuja.

vi.L: Đa-vít tập họp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem tất cả các thủ lĩnh Y-sơ-ra-ên, các thủ lĩnh các chi tộc, các quan chỉ huy các ban phục vụ vua, các quan chỉ huy ngàn quân và các quan chỉ huy trăm quân, các thủ lĩnh cai quản mọi tài sản và súc vật của vua và các con trai vua, cùng với các hoạn quan, các dũng sĩ và mọi người dũng mãnh can trường.
vi.B: Đa-vít tập họp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem tất cả các quan chức Y-sơ-ra-ên: các quan chức của các chi tộc, các quan chỉ huy các ban phục vụ vua, các quan chỉ huy ngàn quân và các quan chỉ huy trăm quân, các quan chức quản lý mọi tài sản và súc vật của vua và các con trai vua, cùng với các triều thần, các dũng sĩ và mọi chiến binh dũng mãnh.
vi.R: Đa-vít triệu tập tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên đến Giê-ru-sa-lem. Trong số đó có những người lãnh đạo các chi tộc, các quan chỉ huy các ban quân phục vụ vua, các quan chỉ huy những đơn vị một ngàn quân và một trăm quân, và những người coi sóc mọi đất đai và bầy gia súc của vua và các con trai vua. Các quan chức trong cung, các chiến binh nổi tiếng và tất cả các chiến binh can đảm khác cũng đến.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 이스라엘의 모든 고관, 곧 지파들의 고관들과 왕을 섬기는 반열들의 지휘관들과 천부장들과 백부장들과 왕과 그의 아들들의 모든 재산과 가축을 맡은 고관들을 내시들과 용사들과 모든 용맹한 용사와 함께 예루살렘으로 모았다.
ko.B: 다윗은 이스라엘의 모든 관리를 예루살렘으로 불러 모았다. 곧 지파의 관리들과 왕을 섬기는 반열의 지휘관들과 천부장들과 백부장들과 왕과 왕자들의 모든 재산과 가축을 맡은 관리들과 함께, 궁중 관리들과 용사들과 모든 용맹한 용사를 모았다.
ko.R: 다윗은 이스라엘의 모든 지도자를 예루살렘으로 불렀다. 지파의 지도자들과 왕을 섬기는 군대 반열의 지휘관들과 천 명을 거느린 지휘관들과 백 명을 거느린 지휘관들이 왔다. 왕과 왕자들의 땅과 가축을 돌보는 지도자들도 왔다. 왕궁의 관리들과 이름난 용사들과 다른 모든 용감한 군인들도 왔다.

pt.L: E Davi reuniu todos os príncipes de Israel, os príncipes das tribos, e os comandantes das turmas que serviam ao rei, e os chefes dos milhares e os chefes das centenas, e os príncipes de todos os bens e do gado do rei e dos seus filhos, junto com os eunucos, e os valentes, e todo valente guerreiro, em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Davi reuniu em Jerusalém todos os oficiais de Israel: os oficiais das tribos, os comandantes das turmas que serviam ao rei, os comandantes de mil e os comandantes de cem, e os oficiais que administravam todos os bens e todo o gado do rei e dos seus filhos, junto com os oficiais da corte, os guerreiros e todo guerreiro valente.
pt.R: Davi chamou todos os líderes de Israel para virem a Jerusalém. Entre eles estavam os líderes das tribos, os comandantes das turmas do exército que serviam ao rei, os comandantes das tropas de mil e de cem soldados, e os líderes que cuidavam de todas as terras e rebanhos do rei e dos seus filhos. Também vieram os oficiais do palácio, os guerreiros famosos e todos os outros guerreiros corajosos.

decisions.choice: the leaders listed in chapter 27
decisions.reason: The groups named here are the ones listed in chapter 27: the commanders of the divisions that served the king month by month (27:1-15), the leaders of the tribes (27:16-22), and the officials over the king's property and herds (27:25-31). David had gathered the leaders of Israel once before, to set the Levites in order (23:2). Now he gathers them all to hand on the kingdom and the plan for the temple to Solomon.

decisions.choice: the eunuchs: high officers of the royal court
decisions.reason: The word can mean a eunuch, a man castrated to serve in a royal household, but it is also the usual word for a high court officer, whether or not he was a eunuch; Potiphar, who had a wife, is called by it (Genesis 39:1). Here it names officers of David's court.

decisions.choice: the mighty men and every mighty man of valor: David's famous warriors and the other men of proven strength
decisions.reason: "The mighty men" are David's band of famous warriors listed in 11:10-47. "Mighty man of valor" is a wider phrase for a capable, proven fighting man (7:2; 12:22), and can also describe a man of standing (Ruth 2:1). Together they take in every leading fighting man in the kingdom.

decisions.choice: princes / officials / leaders; commanders
decisions.reason: As in the terms used for these books: the word for a leader or official is "princes" at Literal, "officials" at Balanced and "leaders" at Readable; where it names the commanders of the army's divisions, thousands and hundreds, every level says "commanders".

decisions.choice: eunuchs / court officials / palace officials; mighty men / warriors / famous fighters; every mighty man of valor / every mighty warrior / all the other brave warriors
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "eunuchs", as the terms for these books do, with the sense explained in m2; Balanced and Readable say "court officials" and "palace officials". "Mighty man of valor" has the wording used throughout 1 Chronicles (7:2). Readable also says "units of a thousand and of a hundred men" and "land and herds" so that the list is easy to follow.

decisions.choice: eunucos (L); funcionarios de la corte (B); funcionarios del palacio (R)
decisions.reason: The *sarisim*, as the terms note: "eunucos" at Literal, "funcionarios" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "eunuques" (L); "hauts fonctionnaires" (B); "fonctionnaires du palais" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings terms note for the court officers (*sarisim*).

decisions.choice: matowashi (L); maafisa wa ikulu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The *sarisim* follow the terms note: "matowashi" (eunuchs) at Literal, "maafisa" at Balanced and Readable, here "maafisa wa ikulu" (court officials), as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: "hoạn quan" (L), "triều thần" (B), "quan chức trong cung" (R)
decisions.reason: The Kings terms note's words for the *sarisim*, eunuchs at Literal and court officials at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "내시" (L); "궁중 관리" (B); "왕궁의 관리" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's words for the *sarisim*: "내시" at Literal, "관리" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: príncipes (L), oficiais (B), líderes (R); os comandantes das turmas; os chefes dos milhares (L), os comandantes de mil (B, R)
decisions.reason: The groups of chapter 27 (m1) keep the words used there in Portuguese: "príncipes" at Literal for the officials' title, as 27:22 and 27:31, "as turmas" for the monthly divisions (27:1), and the officers of 15:25 and 27:1. Balanced and Readable follow the English (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: os eunucos (L), os oficiais da corte (B), os oficiais do palácio (R); os valentes, todo valente guerreiro (L); os guerreiros, todo guerreiro valente (B); os guerreiros famosos, os outros guerreiros corajosos (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-2): Literal keeps "eunucos" and Balanced and Readable give the sense of a high court officer (m2). David's famous warriors keep the words 11:10 sets for the book, and "valente guerreiro" (L), "guerreiro valente" (B), "guerreiro corajoso" (R) is the book's phrase for a proven fighting man (5:24; m3).

source.text: וַיָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל־רַגְלָ֔יו וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שְׁמָע֖וּנִי אַחַ֣י וְעַמִּ֑י אֲנִ֣י עִם־לְבָבִ֡י לִבְנוֹת֩ בֵּ֨ית מְנוּחָ֜ה לַאֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֗ה וְלַהֲדֹם֙ רַגְלֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַהֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לִבְנֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And rose David the king on his feet and said, Hear me, my brothers and my people: I [was] with my heart to build a house of rest for [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh and for [the] footstool of [the] feet of our God, and I prepared to build.

en.L: And David the king rose to his feet and said, "Hear me, my brothers and my people. I [had it] in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and for the footstool of the feet of our God, and I made preparations to build.
en.B: King David stood up and said, "Hear me, my brothers and my people. I had set my heart on building a house where the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} could rest, the footstool of our God, and I made preparations for building it.
en.R: King David stood up and said, "Listen to me, my fellow Israelites, my people. I wanted to build a temple as a lasting home for the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The ark is like the footstool of our God, the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rests {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet as King. So I got everything ready to build it.

es.L: Y se levantó el rey David sobre sus pies y dijo: «{{plural_you:Óiganme|Oídme}}, hermanos míos y pueblo mío. Yo [tenía] en mi corazón edificar una casa de reposo para el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y para el estrado de los pies de nuestro Dios, e hice preparativos para edificar.
es.B: El rey David se puso de pie y dijo: «{{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}}, hermanos míos y pueblo mío. Yo me había propuesto edificar una casa donde reposara el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el estrado de los pies de nuestro Dios, e hice preparativos para edificarla.
es.R: El rey David se puso de pie y dijo: «{{plural_you:Escúchenme|Escuchadme}}, hermanos israelitas, pueblo mío. Yo quería construir un templo que fuera un hogar permanente para el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. El arca es como el estrado de los pies de nuestro Dios, el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} apoya {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies como Rey. Por eso dejé todo listo para construirlo.

fr.L: Et le roi David se leva sur ses pieds et dit : « Écoutez-moi, mes frères et mon peuple. J’avais à cœur de bâtir une maison de repos pour l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et pour le marchepied des pieds de notre Dieu, et j’ai fait des préparatifs pour bâtir.
fr.B: Le roi David se leva et dit : « Écoutez-moi, mes frères et mon peuple. J’avais à cœur de bâtir une maison où l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pourrait reposer, le marchepied de notre Dieu, et j’ai fait des préparatifs pour la construire.
fr.R: Le roi David s’est levé et il a dit : « Écoutez-moi, mes frères israélites, mon peuple. Je voulais construire un temple pour que l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} y ait sa place pour toujours. L’arche est comme le marchepied de notre Dieu, l’endroit où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pose {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds comme un roi. Alors j’ai tout préparé pour le construire.

sw.L: Mfalme Daudi akasimama kwa miguu yake akasema, "Nisikieni, ndugu zangu na watu wangu. Mimi [nilikuwa na nia] moyoni mwangu kujenga nyumba ya kupumzika kwa ajili ya sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kwa ajili ya kiti cha kuwekea miguu cha Mungu wetu, nami nikaandaa kujenga.
sw.B: Mfalme Daudi alisimama akasema, "Nisikilizeni, ndugu zangu na watu wangu. Nilikuwa nimeweka moyoni mwangu kujenga nyumba ambamo sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lingepumzika, kiti cha kuwekea miguu cha Mungu wetu, nami nikafanya maandalizi ya kuijenga.
sw.R: Mfalme Daudi alisimama akasema, "Nisikilizeni, ndugu zangu Waisraeli, watu wangu. Nilitaka kujenga hekalu liwe makao ya kudumu ya sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Sanduku hilo ni kama kiti cha kuwekea miguu cha Mungu wetu, mahali ambapo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huweka miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kama Mfalme. Kwa hiyo niliandaa kila kitu ili kulijenga.

vi.L: Vua Đa-vít đứng dậy và nói: "Hỡi anh em tôi và dân tôi, hãy nghe tôi. Tôi đã có ý trong lòng muốn xây một ngôi nhà an nghỉ cho hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cho bệ chân của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, và tôi đã chuẩn bị để xây.
vi.B: Vua Đa-vít đứng dậy và nói: "Hỡi anh em và dân tôi, hãy nghe tôi. Tôi đã quyết tâm xây một ngôi nhà làm nơi an nghỉ cho hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là bệ chân của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, và tôi đã chuẩn bị để xây.
vi.R: Vua Đa-vít đứng dậy và nói: "Hỡi anh em đồng bào, hỡi dân tôi, hãy nghe tôi. Tôi đã muốn xây một đền thờ làm nơi ở lâu dài cho hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hòm ấy như bệ chân của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, là nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt chân như một vị Vua. Vì vậy tôi đã chuẩn bị mọi thứ để xây.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗 왕이 일어서서 말했다. "내 형제들과 내 백성이여, 내 말을 들으십시오. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤와 우리 하나님의 발등상을 위하여 안식할 집을 지으려는 마음이 있었고, 짓기 위해 준비했습니다.
ko.B: 다윗 왕이 일어서서 말했다. "내 형제들과 내 백성이여, 내 말을 들으십시오. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤, 곧 우리 하나님의 발등상을 둘 안식의 집을 지으려고 마음먹고, 그것을 지으려고 준비해 왔습니다.
ko.R: 다윗 왕이 일어서서 말했다. "이스라엘 동포 여러분, 내 백성이여, 내 말을 들으십시오. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤가 영원히 머물 성전을 짓고 싶었습니다. 언약궤는 우리 하나님의 발등상과 같습니다. 왕이신 그분께서 발을 올려놓으시는 곳입니다. 그래서 나는 성전을 지을 준비를 다 해 두었습니다.

pt.L: E o rei Davi se levantou sobre os seus pés e disse: "Ouçam-me, meus irmãos e meu povo. Eu [tinha] no meu coração construir uma casa para o repouso da arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e para o estrado dos pés do nosso Deus, e fiz preparativos para construir.
pt.B: O rei Davi se pôs de pé e disse: "Ouçam-me, meus irmãos e meu povo. Eu tinha no coração o desejo de construir uma casa onde a arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} pudesse repousar, o estrado dos pés do nosso Deus, e fiz os preparativos para a construção.
pt.R: O rei Davi se levantou e disse: "Escutem, meus irmãos israelitas, meu povo. Eu queria construir um templo para ser a casa definitiva da arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. A arca é como o estrado dos pés do nosso Deus, o lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apoia os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés como Rei. Por isso preparei tudo para construí-lo.

decisions.choice: I had it in my heart: I intended, I wanted
decisions.reason: "With my heart" means in his mind and will: it was what he meant to do. David first spoke of this plan to Nathan (17:1-2), and he told Solomon the same words (22:7).

decisions.choice: a house of rest: a settled, lasting place for the ark
decisions.reason: The ark had been carried from place to place since the wilderness (Numbers 10:33-36) and had stood in a tent in Jerusalem (16:1). A "house of rest" is a home where it would stay. The same picture is in Psalm 132:8, 14, "Arise, LORD, to your resting place", and the singers were appointed "after the ark came to rest" (6:16). The word also echoes the promise of rest to Solomon, "a man of rest" (22:9).

decisions.choice: the footstool of our God: the ark, with God pictured as a king enthroned above it
decisions.reason: The LORD is pictured as a king "enthroned on the cherubim" above the ark (13:6), with the ark as the stool for his feet (Psalm 99:5; 132:7). The "and" here joins two names for the same thing: the house is for the ark, which is God's footstool. God is not thought of as contained in the ark; it is the place on earth where the heavenly King meets his people.

decisions.choice: I made preparations: the gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood and stone David had gathered
decisions.reason: David had already stored up materials and workers for the temple (22:2-5, 14-16), and he will list his gifts again in 29:2-5.

decisions.choice: my fellow Israelites; the place where he rests his feet as King
decisions.reason: Readable says "fellow Israelites" for "brothers", since David is speaking to his people, not his own brothers. It explains the picture of the footstool in a short sentence (m3) and says "temple" for the house.

decisions.choice: Óiganme / Oídme; Escúchenme / Escuchadme
decisions.reason: David speaks to the whole gathering, so his commands and every "you" to them in this speech take the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: David’s speech in the passé composé at every level
decisions.reason: Speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level, as the French style guide sets; only the narration around it follows the level’s narrative tense.

decisions.choice: David says "tôi" and calls the assembly "anh em"
decisions.reason: David calls them "my brothers"; Vietnamese "anh em" with "tôi" keeps that closeness, as he speaks to the assembly in 13:2.

decisions.choice: David speaks to the assembly in 합쇼체 ("들으십시오") with "내 형제들과 내 백성이여" (L, B), "이스라엘 동포 여러분" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 13:2, the king addresses the whole assembly respectfully; to Solomon (verses 9-10, 20-21) he speaks 해라체.

decisions.choice: uma casa para o repouso da arca (L); uma casa onde a arca pudesse repousar (B); a casa definitiva da arca (R); o estrado dos pés (every level)
decisions.reason: "Casa de repouso" is the Brazilian name for a home for the elderly, so Literal turns the phrase to "uma casa para o repouso da arca", keeping the word of rest (m2) without that reading. "Estrado" is the Portuguese word for the footstool of a throne, which keeps the picture of the LORD enthroned above the ark (m3).

decisions.choice: Ouçam-me, Escutem (vocês)
decisions.reason: The king addresses the whole gathering as his "brothers" and people, so he speaks with "vocês", as a king speaks to his subjects throughout Samuel and Kings in Portuguese. Readable says "meus irmãos israelitas", as the English says "fellow Israelites" (r-en-1).

source.text: וְהָאֱלֹהִים֙ אָ֣מַר לִ֔י לֹא־תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֖יִת לִשְׁמִ֑י כִּ֣י אִ֧ישׁ מִלְחָמ֛וֹת אַ֖תָּה וְדָמִ֥ים שָׁפָֽכְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And God said to me, Not you will build a house for my name, for a man of wars [are] you, and bloods you have shed.

en.L: But God said to me, 'You shall not build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, for you [are] a man of wars and have shed blood.'
en.B: But God said to me, 'You will not build a house for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, for you are a man of war and you have poured out blood.'
en.R: But God told me, 'You will not be the one to build a temple for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, because you are a warrior and you have spilled blood.'

es.L: Pero Dios me dijo: ‘No edificarás casa a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, porque eres hombre de guerras y has derramado sangre’.
es.B: Pero Dios me dijo: ‘No edificarás una casa para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, porque eres un hombre de guerra y has derramado sangre’.
es.R: Pero Dios me dijo: ‘No serás tú quien construya un templo para {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, porque eres un guerrero y has derramado sangre’.

fr.L: Mais Dieu m’a dit : “Tu ne bâtiras pas de maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, car tu [es] un homme de guerres et tu as versé le sang.”
fr.B: Mais Dieu m’a dit : “Tu ne bâtiras pas de maison pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, car tu es un homme de guerre et tu as répandu le sang.”
fr.R: Mais Dieu m’a dit : “Ce n’est pas toi qui construiras un temple pour {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, parce que tu es un guerrier et que tu as fait couler le sang.”

sw.L: Lakini Mungu akaniambia, 'Wewe hutajenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, kwa maana wewe [ni] mtu wa vita, nawe umemwaga damu.'
sw.B: Lakini Mungu aliniambia, 'Hutajenga nyumba kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, kwa maana wewe ni mtu wa vita, nawe umemwaga damu.'
sw.R: Lakini Mungu aliniambia, 'Wewe hutakuwa ndiye wa kujenga hekalu kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, kwa sababu wewe ni mpiganaji, nawe umemwaga damu.'

vi.L: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời phán với tôi: 'Ngươi sẽ không xây nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì ngươi [là] người của chiến tranh và đã làm đổ máu.'
vi.B: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời phán với tôi: 'Con sẽ không xây nhà cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì con là người của chiến trận và đã làm đổ máu.'
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời phán với tôi: 'Con sẽ không phải là người xây đền thờ cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì con là một chiến binh và đã làm đổ máu.'

ko.L: 그러나 하나님께서 나에게 말씀하셨습니다. '너는 내 이름을 위하여 집을 짓지 못할 것이다. 너는 전쟁의 사람이고 피를 흘렸기 때문이다.'
ko.B: 그러나 하나님께서 나에게 말씀하셨습니다. '너는 내 이름을 위하여 집을 짓지 못할 것이다. 너는 전쟁을 많이 한 사람이고 피를 흘렸기 때문이다.'
ko.R: 그러나 하나님께서는 나에게 말씀하셨습니다. '내 이름을 높이는 성전을 지을 사람은 네가 아니다. 너는 전쟁을 하는 사람이었고 피를 흘렸기 때문이다.'

pt.L: Mas Deus me disse: 'Tu não construirás uma casa para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, porque és homem de guerras e derramaste sangue.'
pt.B: Mas Deus me disse: 'Não construirás uma casa para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, porque és um homem de guerra e derramaste sangue.'
pt.R: Mas Deus me disse: 'Não serás tu quem vai construir um templo para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, porque és um guerreiro e derramaste sangue.'

decisions.choice: a man of wars who has shed blood: as David told Solomon in 22:8
decisions.reason: David told Solomon the same thing in 22:8, in fuller words: "You have shed much blood and fought great wars." Neither place calls David's wars sins; they were the LORD's battles (14:10-16; 18:6, 13). But the house of the LORD was to be built by a man of peace, Solomon, whose name sounds like the word for peace (22:9). 1 Kings 5:17 gives another side of it: David was kept busy by wars all around him.

decisions.choice: a house for my name: the temple, the place where God makes himself known and is called on
decisions.reason: God's name stands for God himself as he makes himself known. A house "for his name" is the place he chooses to be worshiped and called on (Deuteronomy 12:5, 11; 2 Samuel 7:13; 1 Kings 8:29).

decisions.choice: blood: bloodshed, the killing of people
decisions.reason: The word "blood" is plural here, as often when it means blood shed by violence (Genesis 4:10). It points to the many killed in David's wars.

decisions.choice: a temple for my name; a warrior
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for the house, as in 22:8, whose wording this verse follows, and "warrior" for "man of wars".

decisions.choice: tu (God to David)
decisions.reason: God speaks to David as to one person, with "tu", as in the promise of 2 Samuel 7 in Portuguese, and "uma casa para o meu nome" keeps the words of 2 Samuel 7:13 (m2).

source.text: וַיִּבְחַ֡ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בִּ֜י מִכֹּ֣ל בֵּית־אָבִ֗י לִהְי֨וֹת לְמֶ֤לֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְעוֹלָ֔ם כִּ֤י בִֽיהוּדָה֙ בָּחַ֣ר לְנָגִ֔יד וּבְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י וּבִבְנֵ֣י אָבִ֔י בִּ֣י רָצָ֔ה לְהַמְלִ֖יךְ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And chose Yahweh [the] God of Israel in me from all [the] house of my father to be for king over Israel forever; for in Judah he chose for ruler, and in [the] house of Judah [the] house of my father, and among [the] sons of my father in me he took pleasure to make king over all Israel.

en.L: Yet {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose Judah as ruler, and in the house of Judah the house of my father, and among the sons of my father {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took pleasure in me, to make [me] king over all Israel.
en.B: Still, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, chose me from my whole family to be king over Israel forever. He chose Judah to lead, and among the people of Judah {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose my father's family, and from my father's sons it pleased {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to make me king over all Israel.
en.R: Even so, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, chose me out of my whole family to be king over Israel, and my family after me forever. He chose the tribe of Judah to lead. From Judah {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose my father's family. And from all my father's sons, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was glad to choose me and make me king over all Israel.

es.L: Sin embargo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios de Israel me escogió de toda la casa de mi padre para que fuera rey sobre Israel para siempre. Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escogió a Judá como príncipe, y en la casa de Judá la casa de mi padre, y entre los hijos de mi padre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se agradó de mí para hacer[me] rey sobre todo Israel.
es.B: Aun así, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, me escogió de toda mi familia para que fuera rey sobre Israel para siempre. Escogió a Judá para que gobernara, y de entre el pueblo de Judá {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escogió a la familia de mi padre, y de entre los hijos de mi padre {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agradó hacerme rey sobre todo Israel.
es.R: Aun así, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, me escogió de toda mi familia para que fuera rey de Israel, y mi familia después de mí para siempre. Escogió a la tribu de Judá para que gobernara. De Judá {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escogió a la familia de mi padre. Y de todos los hijos de mi padre, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiso escogerme a mí y hacerme rey de todo Israel.

fr.L: Pourtant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, m’a choisi dans toute la maison de mon père pour être roi sur Israël pour toujours. Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi Juda comme chef, et dans la maison de Juda, la maison de mon père, et parmi les fils de mon père, c’est en moi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a pris plaisir, pour [me] faire roi sur tout Israël.
fr.B: Pourtant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, m’a choisi dans toute ma famille pour être roi sur Israël pour toujours. Il a choisi Juda pour être chef ; dans la tribu de Juda, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi la famille de mon père ; et parmi les fils de mon père, il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a plu de me faire roi sur tout Israël.
fr.R: Malgré cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, m’a choisi dans toute ma famille pour être roi d’Israël, moi et ma descendance pour toujours. Il a choisi la tribu de Juda pour diriger. Dans Juda, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi la famille de mon père. Et parmi tous les fils de mon père, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été heureux de me choisir pour faire de moi le roi de tout Israël.

sw.L: Hata hivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli alinichagua katika nyumba yote ya baba yangu niwe mfalme juu ya Israeli milele. Kwa maana alimchagua Yuda kuwa kiongozi, na katika nyumba ya Yuda nyumba ya baba yangu, na katika wana wa baba yangu alipendezwa nami, kunifanya mfalme juu ya Israeli wote.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, alinichagua katika jamaa yangu yote niwe mfalme juu ya Israeli milele. Alimchagua Yuda awe kiongozi, na katika watu wa Yuda akaichagua jamaa ya baba yangu, na katika wana wa baba yangu alipendezwa kunifanya mfalme juu ya Israeli wote.
sw.R: Hata hivyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, alinichagua katika jamaa yangu yote niwe mfalme juu ya Israeli, mimi na jamaa yangu baada yangu milele. Alilichagua kabila la Yuda liongoze. Katika Yuda akaichagua jamaa ya baba yangu. Na katika wana wote wa baba yangu, alifurahi kunichagua mimi na kunifanya mfalme juu ya Israeli wote.

vi.L: Thế nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên đã chọn tôi từ cả nhà cha tôi để làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên đời đời. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn Giu-đa làm người lãnh đạo, và trong nhà Giu-đa, nhà cha tôi, và trong các con trai cha tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng về tôi, để lập [tôi] làm vua trên cả Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Tuy vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã chọn tôi từ cả gia đình tôi để làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên đời đời. Ngài đã chọn Giu-đa để lãnh đạo, và trong dân Giu-đa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chọn gia đình cha tôi, và trong các con trai cha tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng lập tôi làm vua trên cả Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Dù vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã chọn tôi từ cả gia đình tôi để làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên, và chọn gia đình tôi sau tôi đời đời. Ngài đã chọn chi tộc Giu-đa để lãnh đạo. Trong Giu-đa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chọn gia đình cha tôi. Và trong tất cả các con trai cha tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng chọn tôi và lập tôi làm vua trên cả Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그러나 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 아버지의 온 집 가운데서 나를 택하셔서 영원히 이스라엘의 왕이 되게 하셨습니다. 그분께서 유다를 지도자로 택하셨고, 유다의 집에서 내 아버지의 집을 [택하셨고], 내 아버지의 아들들 가운데서 나를 기뻐하셔서 온 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우셨습니다.
ko.B: 그래도 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 내 아버지의 온 집안 가운데서 나를 택하셔서 영원히 이스라엘의 왕이 되게 하셨습니다. 그분께서는 유다를 지도자로 택하시고, 유다 사람들 가운데서 내 아버지의 집안을 택하시고, 내 아버지의 아들들 가운데서 나를 기쁘게 여기셔서 온 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우셨습니다.
ko.R: 그래도 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 내 온 집안 가운데서 나를 택하셔서 이스라엘의 왕이 되게 하시고, 내 자손이 영원히 왕이 되게 하셨습니다. 그분께서는 유다 지파를 택하셔서 다른 지파들을 이끌게 하셨습니다. 유다 지파 가운데서 내 아버지의 집안을 택하셨습니다. 그리고 내 아버지의 아들들 가운데서 기꺼이 나를 택하셔서 온 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우셨습니다.

pt.L: Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, me escolheu dentre toda a casa do meu pai para ser rei sobre Israel para sempre. Pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu Judá para príncipe, e na casa de Judá, a casa do meu pai, e entre os filhos do meu pai {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se agradou de mim, para [me] fazer rei sobre todo o Israel.
pt.B: Mesmo assim, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, me escolheu de toda a minha família para ser rei sobre Israel para sempre. Ele escolheu Judá para liderar, e entre o povo de Judá {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu a família do meu pai, e entre os filhos do meu pai {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se agradou de me fazer rei sobre todo o Israel.
pt.R: Mesmo assim, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, me escolheu dentre toda a minha família para ser rei sobre Israel, eu e a minha família depois de mim, para sempre. Ele escolheu a tribo de Judá para liderar. De Judá {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu a família do meu pai. E, entre todos os filhos do meu pai, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quis me escolher e me fazer rei sobre todo o Israel.

decisions.choice: the LORD's choosing: Judah, David's family, David, and then Solomon
decisions.reason: David traces a chain of the LORD's choices, each narrower than the last: the tribe of Judah, the family of Jesse, David himself, and in the next verse Solomon. The word "chose" comes four times in verses 4-6 and again in verse 10. The kingship is not something David won for himself; it is God's gift.

decisions.choice: ruler: the one appointed to lead
decisions.reason: The word means a leader set over others by God. Judah was to lead among the tribes (Genesis 49:8-10), and 5:2 says "Judah grew strong among his brothers, and a ruler came from him".

decisions.choice: among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me: David chosen over Jesse's older sons
decisions.reason: In 1 Samuel 16:1-13 Samuel passes over Jesse's seven older sons and anoints David, the youngest, because "the LORD looks on the heart". David's brothers are named in 2:13-15.

decisions.choice: king over Israel forever: through David's line of descendants
decisions.reason: David himself would die, so "forever" looks to the line of kings that would come from him, as the LORD promised in 17:11-14.

decisions.choice: my father's family; the people / tribe of Judah
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "family" for the "house" of David's father and "people" or "tribe" for the "house" of Judah. Literal keeps "house".

decisions.choice: and my family after me forever
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that the promise "forever" is for David's family after him (m4).

decisions.choice: para príncipe (L); para liderar (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word is the title of a leader appointed by God (m2), "príncipe" at Literal as 5:2 sets it, where the same verse says a ruler came from Judah; Balanced and Readable say what Judah was chosen for, "liderar", as the English says "to lead".

source.text: וּמִכָּ֨ל־בָּנַ֔י כִּ֚י רַבִּ֣ים בָּנִ֔ים נָ֥תַן לִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּבְחַר֙ בִּשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֔י לָשֶׁ֗בֶת עַל־כִּסֵּ֛א מַלְכ֥וּת יְהוָ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And from all my sons, for many sons has given to me Yahweh, and he chose Solomon my son to sit on [the] throne of [the] kingdom of Yahweh over Israel.

en.L: And of all my sons, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given me many sons, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} over Israel.
en.B: And of all my sons, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has given me many, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s kingdom over Israel.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has given me many sons. But out of all of them, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne and rule Israel for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because the kingdom belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y de todos mis hijos, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha dado muchos hijos, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha escogido a Salomón mi hijo para que se siente en el trono del reino {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sobre Israel.
es.B: Y de todos mis hijos, pues {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha dado muchos, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha escogido a mi hijo Salomón para que se siente en el trono del reino {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sobre Israel.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ha dado muchos hijos. Pero de todos ellos, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha escogido a mi hijo Salomón para que se siente en el trono y gobierne a Israel en nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque el reino es {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et parmi tous mes fils, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a donné beaucoup de fils, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi Salomon mon fils pour s’asseoir sur le trône de la royauté {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sur Israël.
fr.B: Et parmi tous mes fils, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’en a donné beaucoup, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi mon fils Salomon pour s’asseoir sur le trône du royaume {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sur Israël.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a donné beaucoup de fils. Mais parmi eux tous, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a choisi mon fils Salomon pour s’asseoir sur le trône et gouverner Israël pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car le royaume appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na katika wana wangu wote, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenipa wana wengi, amemchagua Sulemani mwanangu aketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Na katika wana wangu wote, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenipa wana wengi, amemchagua mwanangu Sulemani aketi juu ya kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenipa wana wengi. Lakini katika wote hao, amemchagua mwanangu Sulemani aketi juu ya kiti cha enzi na kutawala Israeli kwa niaba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu ufalme ni mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Trong tất cả các con trai tôi, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho tôi nhiều con trai, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn Sa-lô-môn con tôi để ngồi trên ngai vương quốc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Trong tất cả các con trai tôi, mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho tôi nhiều lắm, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn Sa-lô-môn con tôi để ngồi trên ngai vương quốc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho tôi nhiều con trai. Nhưng trong tất cả các con ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn Sa-lô-môn con tôi để ngồi trên ngai và thay {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên, vì vương quốc thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 내 모든 아들 가운데서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 많은 아들을 주셨는데, 그분께서 내 아들 솔로몬을 택하셔서 이스라엘 위에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 나라의 왕좌에 앉게 하셨습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나에게 많은 아들을 주셨는데, 그 모든 아들 가운데서 그분께서 내 아들 솔로몬을 택하셔서 이스라엘을 다스리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 나라의 왕좌에 앉게 하셨습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 나에게 많은 아들을 주셨습니다. 그러나 그 가운데서 그분께서는 내 아들 솔로몬을 택하셔서 왕좌에 앉아 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 대신하여 이스라엘을 다스리게 하셨습니다. 이 나라는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 나라이기 때문입니다.

pt.L: E de todos os meus filhos, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me deu muitos filhos, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu Salomão, o meu filho, para se sentar no trono do reino {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} sobre Israel.
pt.B: E de todos os meus filhos, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me deu muitos, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu o meu filho Salomão para se sentar no trono do reino {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} sobre Israel.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me deu muitos filhos. Mas, dentre todos eles, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} escolheu o meu filho Salomão para se sentar no trono e governar Israel para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, porque o reino pertence {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the throne of the kingdom of the LORD: the kingdom is the LORD's, and the king rules it for him
decisions.reason: Chronicles says again and again that the kingdom over Israel belongs to the LORD and that David's son sits on the LORD's throne: "I will set him in my house and in my kingdom" (17:14); "Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king" (29:23; also 2 Chronicles 9:8; 13:8). The king of David's line is the LORD's deputy, not the owner of the kingdom.

decisions.choice: of all my sons he has chosen Solomon
decisions.reason: David's many sons are listed in 3:1-9 and 14:3-7, and Solomon was not the eldest. 1 Kings 1 tells how his older brother Adonijah tried to take the throne. Chronicles says only that the LORD chose Solomon, as he had promised (22:9-10).

decisions.choice: for the LORD has given me many sons: an aside within the sentence
decisions.reason: The words about many sons break into the sentence, which then picks up again with "and he has chosen". They stress how great a choice God made.

decisions.choice: rule Israel for the LORD, because the kingdom belongs to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable puts the aside first, as its own sentence, and spells out what "the throne of the kingdom of the LORD" means (m1).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔י שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בִנְךָ֔ הֽוּא־יִבְנֶ֥ה בֵיתִ֖י וַחֲצֵרוֹתָ֑י כִּי־בָחַ֨רְתִּי ב֥וֹ לִי֙ לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶה־לּ֥וֹ לְאָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, Solomon your son, he will build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him for me for a son, and I will be to him for a father.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to me, 'Solomon your son, he will build {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} courts, for I have chosen him to be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} son, and I will be to him a father.
en.B: He said to me, 'Your son Solomon is the one who will build {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} courts. I have chosen him as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} son, and I will be a father to him.
en.R: He told me, 'Your son Solomon is the one who will build {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple and its courtyards. I have chosen him as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} son, and I will be his father.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me dijo: ‘Salomón tu hijo, él edificará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} atrios, porque lo he escogido para que me sea hijo, y yo le seré padre.
es.B: Me dijo: ‘Tu hijo Salomón es quien edificará {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} atrios. Lo he escogido como hijo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, y yo seré un padre para él.
es.R: Me dijo: ‘Tu hijo Salomón es quien construirá {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo y sus patios. Lo he escogido como {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} hijo, y yo seré su padre.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a dit : “Salomon ton fils, c’est lui qui bâtira {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} parvis, car je l’ai choisi pour qu’il soit {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} fils, et moi je serai pour lui un père.
fr.B: Il m’a dit : “C’est ton fils Salomon qui bâtira {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} parvis. Je l’ai choisi pour qu’il soit {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} fils, et je serai pour lui un père.
fr.R: Il m’a dit : “C’est ton fils Salomon qui construira {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple et ses cours. Je l’ai choisi pour qu’il soit {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} fils, et je serai son père.

sw.L: Naye akaniambia, 'Sulemani mwanao, yeye ndiye atakayejenga nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na nyua {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, kwa maana nimemchagua kuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa kwake baba.
sw.B: Akaniambia, 'Mwanao Sulemani ndiye atakayejenga nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na nyua {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}. Nimemchagua kuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa baba yake.
sw.R: Aliniambia, 'Mwanao Sulemani ndiye atakayejenga hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na nyua zake. Nimemchagua kuwa mwanangu, nami nitakuwa baba yake.

vi.L: Ngài phán với tôi: 'Sa-lô-môn con ngươi, chính người sẽ xây nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và các sân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn người làm con {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cha người.
vi.B: Ngài phán với tôi: 'Sa-lô-môn con của con chính là người sẽ xây nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và các sân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta đã chọn người làm con {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là cha của người.
vi.R: Ngài phán với tôi: 'Sa-lô-môn con của con chính là người sẽ xây đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và các sân của đền thờ. Ta đã chọn người làm con {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là cha của người.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨습니다. '네 아들 솔로몬, 그가 내 집과 내 뜰들을 지을 것이다. 내가 그를 택하여 내 아들로 삼았으니, 나는 그에게 아버지가 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨습니다. '내 집과 내 뜰들을 지을 사람은 네 아들 솔로몬이다. 내가 그를 택하여 내 아들로 삼았으니, 나는 그의 아버지가 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그분께서 나에게 말씀하셨습니다. '내 성전과 그 뜰들을 지을 사람은 네 아들 솔로몬이다. 내가 그를 택하여 내 아들로 삼았으니, 나는 그의 아버지가 될 것이다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} me disse: 'Salomão, o teu filho, ele construirá a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} pátios, porque eu o escolhi para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} como filho, e eu serei para ele pai.
pt.B: Ele me disse: 'O teu filho Salomão é quem vai construir a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} pátios. Eu o escolhi como {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} filho, e eu serei pai para ele.
pt.R: Ele me disse: 'O teu filho Salomão é quem vai construir o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} templo e os seus pátios. Eu o escolhi como {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} filho, e eu serei o pai dele.

decisions.choice: he will build my house; I will be his father: the promise of 17:12-13 and 22:10
decisions.reason: The words repeat the LORD's promise through Nathan (17:12-13) and David's words to Solomon (22:10). What is new is "I have chosen him": in 17:11 the son who would build was not named. Now God's choice is said to fall on Solomon.

decisions.choice: my son, his father: a bond of covenant care and loyalty
decisions.reason: As in 17:13: the LORD takes the king into a relation like that of father and son. He will care for him and guide him, and the king is to honor and obey him (Psalm 2:7; 89:27-28).

decisions.choice: he will build: he, and no one else
decisions.reason: The word "he" is stressed, as in 17:12: it is Solomon, not David, who will build.

decisions.choice: my courts: the open courtyards around the temple
decisions.reason: The temple stood within walled courtyards where the people gathered and the altar stood (verse 12; 1 Kings 6:36; 2 Chronicles 4:9).

decisions.choice: I will be to him a father (Literal); I will be a father to him (Balanced); I will be his father (Readable)
decisions.reason: Each level uses the same wording as 17:13.

decisions.choice: "그에게 아버지가 될 것이다" (L); "그의 아버지가 될 것이다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the wording of 17:13 in Korean.

decisions.choice: eu serei para ele pai (L); eu serei pai para ele (B); eu serei o pai dele (R)
decisions.reason: The promise of 17:13 and 2 Samuel 7:14 (m1, m2), in the words of 2 Samuel 7:14 in Portuguese at each level, as the English keeps the wording of 17:13 (r-en-1). "Os meus pátios" for the temple courts (m4), the word of 1 Kings 6:36 in Portuguese.

source.text: וַהֲכִינוֹתִ֥י אֶת־מַלְכוּת֖וֹ עַד־לְעוֹלָ֑ם אִם־יֶחֱזַ֗ק לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת מִצְוֺתַ֥י וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will establish his kingdom until forever, if he will be strong to do my commandments and my judgments as the day the this.

en.L: And I will establish his kingdom forever, if he is resolute to do {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} judgments, as [at] this day.'
en.B: I will make his kingdom firm forever if he holds firmly to doing {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rulings, as he does today.'
en.R: I will make his kingdom last forever, if he keeps on obeying {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands and rules as he does now.'

es.L: Y afirmaré su reino para siempre, si él se mantiene firme en cumplir {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} decretos, como en este día’.
es.B: Haré firme su reino para siempre si se mantiene firme en cumplir {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas, como lo hace hoy’.
es.R: Haré que su reino dure para siempre, si sigue obedeciendo {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandatos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas como lo hace ahora’.

fr.L: Et j’affermirai sa royauté pour toujours, s’il s’attache fermement à pratiquer {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles, comme [en] ce jour.”
fr.B: J’affermirai son royaume pour toujours, s’il reste ferme dans la pratique de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles, comme il le fait aujourd’hui.”
fr.R: Je ferai durer son royaume pour toujours, s’il continue à obéir à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements et à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles, comme il le fait maintenant.”

sw.L: Nami nitauimarisha ufalme wake milele, ikiwa atakuwa thabiti kuzitenda amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, kama [ilivyo] siku hii ya leo.'
sw.B: Nitauimarisha ufalme wake milele ikiwa atashikilia kwa uthabiti kuzitenda amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na maamuzi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kama anavyofanya leo.'
sw.R: Nitaufanya ufalme wake udumu milele, ikiwa ataendelea kutii amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kama anavyofanya sasa.'

vi.L: Ta sẽ lập vững vương quốc người đến đời đời, nếu người vững lòng làm theo các điều răn và mạng lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như ngày nay.'
vi.B: Ta sẽ làm cho vương quốc người vững bền đời đời, nếu người kiên quyết làm theo các điều răn và mạng lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như người đang làm hôm nay.'
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho vương quốc người tồn tại đời đời, nếu người cứ vâng giữ các mệnh lệnh và quy định của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như hiện nay.'

ko.L: 그리고 그가 오늘처럼 내 계명과 내 법도를 행하기를 굳게 하면, 내가 그의 나라를 영원히 굳게 세우겠다.'
ko.B: 그가 지금처럼 내 계명과 내 법도를 굳게 지켜 행하면, 내가 그의 나라를 영원히 튼튼하게 하겠다.'
ko.R: 그가 지금처럼 내 명령과 규칙을 계속 지키면, 내가 그의 나라가 영원히 이어지게 하겠다.'

pt.L: E estabelecerei o reino dele para sempre, se ele for firme em cumprir os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos e as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} ordenanças, como [é] neste dia.'
pt.B: Firmarei o reino dele para sempre, se ele se mantiver firme em cumprir os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos e as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} ordenanças, como faz hoje.'
pt.R: Vou fazer o reino dele durar para sempre, se ele continuar obedecendo aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos e às {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} regras, como faz agora.'

decisions.choice: if he is resolute: the promise to Solomon himself depends on his obedience
decisions.reason: The promise to David's line was given without condition (17:13-14). Here a condition is added for Solomon: his kingdom will stand if he keeps on obeying. David says the same to Solomon in verse 9, and the LORD says it to him in 2 Chronicles 7:17-22 (1 Kings 9:4-9).

decisions.choice: be resolute: be strong, hold firm
decisions.reason: The verb means to be strong. Here it is to hold on firmly and keep on doing what God commands. It is the same verb as "be strong" in verses 10 and 20.

decisions.choice: as at this day: as he does now
decisions.reason: The phrase means "as is the case today". It most likely says that Solomon is to go on obeying as he does at present. It could also mean "as you see today", pointing to the present moment as proof, but the sense of the condition is the same.

decisions.choice: commandments and judgments / commandments and rulings / commands and rules
decisions.reason: As in the terms used for these books, from Numbers to Ruth.

decisions.choice: mandamentos e ordenanças (L, B); mandamentos e regras (R)
decisions.reason: The terms of the Pentateuch and of 1 Kings 2:3 in Portuguese, level by level (r-en-1). Readable needs two possessives where the English has one ("my commands and rules"), since a Portuguese possessive agrees with each noun, so each takes the deity_pronoun span.

source.text: וְ֠עַתָּה לְעֵינֵ֨י כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל קְהַל־יְהוָה֙ וּבְאָזְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ שִׁמְר֣וּ וְדִרְשׁ֔וּ כָּל־מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽירְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה וְהִנְחַלְתֶּ֛ם לִבְנֵיכֶ֥ם אַחֲרֵיכֶ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And now, to [the] eyes of all Israel, [the] assembly of Yahweh, and in [the] ears of our God: keep and seek all [the] commandments of Yahweh your God, so that you may possess the land the good and cause [it] to inherit to your sons after you until forever.

en.L: And now, in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and in the hearing of our God: keep and seek all the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, so that you may possess the good land and leave [it] as an inheritance to your {{gender:children|sons}} after you forever.
en.B: So now, before the eyes of all Israel, the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and with our God listening, I charge you: keep all the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and seek them out, so that you may keep possession of the good land and leave it to your descendants after you as their inheritance forever.
en.R: So now, with all Israel here as witnesses, the people gathered for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and with our God listening, I tell you this: Be careful to obey all the commands of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and try hard to know them. Then you will keep this good land and pass it on to your descendants to be theirs forever.

es.L: Y ahora, ante los ojos de todo Israel, la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y a oídos de nuestro Dios: {{plural_you:guarden y busquen|guardad y buscad}} todos los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, para que {{plural_you:posean|poseáis}} la buena tierra y la {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} en herencia a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos después de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} para siempre.
es.B: Así que ahora, ante los ojos de todo Israel, la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y mientras nuestro Dios escucha, {{plural_you:les|os}} encargo: {{plural_you:guarden|guardad}} todos los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios y {{plural_you:búsquenlos|buscadlos}}, para que {{plural_you:sigan poseyendo|sigáis poseyendo}} esta buena tierra y la {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} en herencia a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} descendientes para siempre.
es.R: Así que ahora, con todo Israel aquí como testigo, el pueblo reunido para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y mientras nuestro Dios escucha, {{plural_you:les|os}} digo esto: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado de obedecer todos los mandatos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, y {{plural_you:esfuércense|esforzaos}} por conocerlos. Así {{plural_you:conservarán|conservaréis}} esta buena tierra y se la {{plural_you:pasarán|pasaréis}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} descendientes para que sea suya para siempre.

fr.L: Et maintenant, aux yeux de tout Israël, l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et aux oreilles de notre Dieu : gardez et recherchez tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, afin que vous possédiez ce bon pays et que vous le laissiez en héritage à vos {{gender:enfants|fils}} après vous pour toujours.
fr.B: Maintenant donc, sous les yeux de tout Israël, l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et devant notre Dieu qui écoute, je vous le demande : gardez tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu et appliquez-vous à les connaître, afin que vous restiez en possession de ce bon pays et que vous le laissiez en héritage à vos descendants après vous pour toujours.
fr.R: Maintenant, devant tout Israël, le peuple rassemblé pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et devant notre Dieu qui écoute, je vous le dis : faites bien attention à obéir à tous les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} votre Dieu, et cherchez à bien les connaître. Alors vous garderez ce bon pays et vous le transmettrez à vos descendants, pour qu’il soit à eux pour toujours.

sw.L: Basi sasa, machoni pa Israeli wote, kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na masikioni mwa Mungu wetu: shikeni na kutafuta amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, ili mpate kuimiliki nchi hii nzuri na kuwaachia watoto wenu baada yenu [iwe] urithi milele.
sw.B: Basi sasa, mbele ya macho ya Israeli wote, kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na Mungu wetu akisikia, nawaagiza: shikeni amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu na kuzitafuta, ili mpate kuendelea kuimiliki nchi hii nzuri na kuwaachia wazao wenu baada yenu iwe urithi wao milele.
sw.R: Basi sasa, Israeli wote wakiwa hapa kama mashahidi, watu waliokusanyika kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na Mungu wetu akisikia, nawaambia hivi: Kuweni waangalifu kutii amri zote za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, na jitahidini kuzijua. Ndipo mtaendelea kuimiliki nchi hii nzuri na kuwarithisha wazao wenu iwe yao milele.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, trước mắt cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, là hội chúng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và trong tai Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta: hãy giữ và tìm cầu mọi điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, để anh em được sở hữu xứ tốt đẹp này và để lại [xứ ấy] làm sản nghiệp cho con cháu anh em sau mình đến đời đời.
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, trước mắt cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, là hội chúng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và có Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta lắng nghe, tôi truyền cho anh em: hãy giữ và chuyên tâm tìm hiểu mọi điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, để anh em giữ được xứ tốt đẹp này và để lại làm sản nghiệp cho con cháu anh em đời đời.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ, có cả Y-sơ-ra-ên ở đây làm chứng, là dân chúng nhóm lại cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và có Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta lắng nghe, tôi nói với anh em điều này: Hãy cẩn thận vâng giữ mọi mệnh lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, và cố gắng hiểu biết các mệnh lệnh ấy. Như vậy anh em sẽ giữ được xứ tốt đẹp này và truyền lại cho con cháu mình làm sản nghiệp đời đời.

ko.L: 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 회중인 온 이스라엘의 눈앞에서, 그리고 우리 하나님께서 들으시는 데서 [말합니다]. 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 계명을 지키고 찾으십시오. 그러면 여러분이 이 좋은 땅을 차지하고, 여러분 뒤에 여러분의 자손에게 영원히 유산으로 물려줄 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 회중인 온 이스라엘이 보는 앞에서, 그리고 우리 하나님께서 들으시는 데서 여러분에게 당부합니다. 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 계명을 지키고 힘써 따르십시오. 그러면 여러분이 이 좋은 땅을 계속 차지하고, 여러분의 자손에게 영원한 유산으로 물려줄 것입니다.
ko.R: 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성인 온 이스라엘이 이 자리에서 보고 있고, 우리 하나님께서 듣고 계십니다. 그러니 내가 여러분에게 말합니다. 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 명령을 잘 지키고, 그것을 알려고 힘쓰십시오. 그러면 여러분은 이 좋은 땅을 지키고, 여러분의 자손에게 물려주어 영원히 그들의 것이 되게 할 것입니다.

pt.L: E agora, aos olhos de todo o Israel, a assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e aos ouvidos do nosso Deus: guardem e busquem todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, para que possuam a boa terra e a deixem como herança aos filhos de vocês depois de vocês, para sempre.
pt.B: Agora, diante dos olhos de todo o Israel, a assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e com o nosso Deus ouvindo, eu ordeno a vocês: guardem todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e procurem conhecê-los, para que continuem possuindo esta boa terra e a deixem como herança para os seus descendentes, para sempre.
pt.R: Agora, com todo o Israel aqui como testemunha, o povo reunido para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, e com o nosso Deus ouvindo, eu digo a vocês: tenham o cuidado de obedecer a todos os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e se esforcem para conhecê-los. Assim vocês vão continuar nesta boa terra e vão passá-la aos seus descendentes, para que seja deles para sempre.

decisions.choice: in the sight of all Israel and in the hearing of our God: a solemn charge before witnesses
decisions.reason: David gives his charge in front of the whole gathering and with God himself as a hearer. Both are witnesses to what is asked of the people and of Solomon.

decisions.choice: keep, seek, your God: spoken to the whole assembly
decisions.reason: The verbs and the word "your" are plural here: David speaks to all who are gathered. In verse 9 he turns to Solomon alone.

decisions.choice: seek: search out, give careful attention to
decisions.reason: The verb means to seek or inquire. With commandments it means to study them and care about doing them. The same verb comes twice in verse 9: the LORD "searches" all hearts, and "if you seek him".

decisions.choice: possess the good land and leave it as an inheritance: keep hold of the land and pass it on
decisions.reason: Israel already lived in the land. The words echo Moses' promises (Deuteronomy 4:1, 21-22, 40; 6:18): obedience keeps the people in the land and lets them hand it down to their children. Disobedience would lose it (Deuteronomy 4:25-27).

decisions.choice: I charge you / I tell you this
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add these words so that the long opening phrase leads clearly into the commands.

decisions.choice: your children / your sons
decisions.reason: The word "sons" here means descendants, men and women. Literal gives "children" with "sons" as the alternative; Balanced and Readable say "descendants".

decisions.choice: hijos (no gender span)
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already covers sons and daughters, so the English gender span on "children / sons" is not repeated, as in the Spanish of Samuel.

decisions.choice: watoto wenu (no gender span)
decisions.reason: "Watoto" already covers sons and daughters, so the Swahili Literal has no second wording for the English gender setting; Balanced and Readable say "wazao" (descendants).

decisions.choice: "con cháu anh em", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "con cháu" already covers sons and daughters, so the English gender setting has no second wording in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "자손"
decisions.reason: Korean "자손" already means descendants of either sex, so the English setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: aos filhos de vocês (L), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal sets "children" against "sons" (r-en-2); the Portuguese plural "filhos" already means sons and daughters, so Literal has one wording and no setting, as at 5:29 in this book. Balanced and Readable say "descendentes", as the English does. "O Deus de vocês" and "guardem" are plural: David speaks to the whole assembly (m2).

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה־בְנִ֡י דַּע֩ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵ֨י אָבִ֜יךָ וְעָבְדֵ֗הוּ בְּלֵ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ וּבְנֶ֣פֶשׁ חֲפֵצָ֔ה כִּ֤י כָל־לְבָבוֹת֙ דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה וְכָל־יֵ֥צֶר מַחֲשָׁב֖וֹת מֵבִ֑ין אִֽם־תִּדְרְשֶׁ֨נּוּ֙ יִמָּ֣צֵא לָ֔ךְ וְאִם־תַּֽעַזְבֶ֖נּוּ יַזְנִיחֲךָ֥ לָעַֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, Solomon my son, know [the] God of your father and serve him with a heart complete and with a soul willing, for all hearts [is] searching Yahweh, and every inclination of thoughts [he is] understanding. If you seek him, he will be found by you, and if you forsake him, he will reject you to forever.

en.L: And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with a complete heart and with a willing soul, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} searches all hearts and understands every intention of the thoughts. If you seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be found by you; but if you forsake {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will reject you forever.
en.B: As for you, my son Solomon, know your father's God, and serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with an undivided heart and a willing soul, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} searches every heart and understands every intention behind people's thoughts. If you seek {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will let you find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; but if you abandon {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will reject you forever.
en.R: And you, Solomon my son, come to know the God your father serves. Serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with all your heart, gladly and willingly. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} looks into every heart, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} understands every plan and every thought. If you look for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, you will find {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. But if you turn away from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will reject you forever.

es.L: Y tú, Salomón hijo mío, conoce al Dios de tu padre y sírvele con corazón íntegro y con alma dispuesta, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escudriña todos los corazones y entiende toda intención de los pensamientos. Si lo buscas, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se dejará hallar por ti; pero si lo abandonas, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te rechazará para siempre.
es.B: En cuanto a ti, hijo mío Salomón, conoce al Dios de tu padre y sírvele con un corazón íntegro y un alma dispuesta, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} examina todos los corazones y entiende toda intención que hay detrás de los pensamientos. Si lo buscas, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dejará que lo encuentres; pero si lo abandonas, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te rechazará para siempre.
es.R: Y tú, Salomón hijo mío, llega a conocer al Dios a quien sirve tu padre. Sírvele de todo corazón, con alegría y de buena gana. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mira dentro de cada corazón, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entiende todo plan y todo pensamiento. Si lo buscas, lo encontrarás. Pero si te apartas de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te rechazará para siempre.

fr.L: Et toi, Salomon mon fils, connais le Dieu de ton père et sers-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} d’un cœur entier et d’une âme bien disposée, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sonde tous les cœurs et discerne toute intention des pensées. Si tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} recherches, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se laissera trouver par toi ; mais si tu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}abandonnes, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te rejettera pour toujours.
fr.B: Quant à toi, mon fils Salomon, connais le Dieu de ton père et sers-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} d’un cœur sans partage et d’une âme bien disposée, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sonde tous les cœurs et discerne toutes les intentions qui inspirent les pensées. Si tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} recherches, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se laissera trouver par toi ; mais si tu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}abandonnes, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te rejettera pour toujours.
fr.R: Et toi, Salomon mon fils, apprends à connaître le Dieu que ton père sert. Sers-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} de tout ton cœur, avec joie et de bon gré. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} voit le fond de tous les cœurs, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} comprend tous les projets et toutes les pensées. Si tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} cherches, tu {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouveras. Mais si tu te détournes de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te rejettera pour toujours.

sw.L: Na wewe, Sulemani mwanangu, umjue Mungu wa baba yako na kumtumikia kwa moyo mkamilifu na kwa nafsi ipendayo, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huichunguza mioyo yote na kuelewa kila kusudi la mawazo. Ukimtafuta, ataonekana kwako; lakini ukimwacha, atakukataa milele.
sw.B: Na wewe, mwanangu Sulemani, umjue Mungu wa baba yako, umtumikie kwa moyo usiogawanyika na kwa nafsi iliyo radhi, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huchunguza kila moyo na kuelewa kila kusudi lililo nyuma ya mawazo ya watu. Ukimtafuta, atakuwezesha kumpata; lakini ukimwacha, atakukataa milele.
sw.R: Na wewe, Sulemani mwanangu, umjue Mungu ambaye baba yako anamtumikia. Umtumikie kwa moyo wako wote, kwa furaha na kwa hiari. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huiangalia kila mioyo, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anaelewa kila mpango na kila wazo. Ukimtafuta, utampata. Lakini ukimwacha, atakukataa milele.

vi.L: Còn con, Sa-lô-môn con ta, hãy nhận biết Đức Chúa Trời của cha con và phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với tấm lòng trọn vẹn và tâm hồn vui lòng, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dò xét mọi lòng và hiểu mọi ý định của tư tưởng. Nếu con tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cho con gặp; nhưng nếu con lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ từ bỏ con đời đời.
vi.B: Còn con, Sa-lô-môn con ta, hãy nhận biết Đức Chúa Trời của cha con, và hết lòng hết ý vui lòng phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dò xét mọi lòng và hiểu mọi ý định trong tư tưởng con người. Nếu con tìm cầu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cho con gặp được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; nhưng nếu con lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ từ bỏ con đời đời.
vi.R: Còn con, Sa-lô-môn con ta, hãy nhận biết Đức Chúa Trời mà cha con phụng sự. Hãy hết lòng phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} một cách vui vẻ và tự nguyện. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhìn thấu mọi tấm lòng, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiểu mọi dự tính và mọi ý nghĩ. Nếu con tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, con sẽ gặp được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nhưng nếu con quay lưng với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ từ bỏ con đời đời.

ko.L: 그리고 너, 내 아들 솔로몬아, 네 아버지의 하나님을 알고, 온전한 마음과 기꺼운 영혼으로 그분을 섬겨라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 마음을 살피시고 생각의 모든 의도를 아시기 때문이다. 네가 그분을 찾으면 그분께서 너를 만나 주실 것이다. 그러나 네가 그분을 버리면 그분께서 너를 영원히 버리실 것이다.
ko.B: 그리고 내 아들 솔로몬아, 너는 네 아버지의 하나님을 알고, 온전한 마음과 기쁜 마음으로 그분을 섬겨라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 마음을 살피시고 사람의 생각 속에 있는 모든 의도를 아신다. 네가 그분을 찾으면 그분께서 너를 만나 주실 것이다. 그러나 네가 그분을 버리면 그분께서 너를 영원히 버리실 것이다.
ko.R: 그리고 내 아들 솔로몬아, 네 아버지가 섬기는 하나님을 알아라. 온 마음을 다해 기쁘게 그분을 섬겨라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모든 사람의 마음속을 들여다보시고, 모든 계획과 생각을 아신다. 네가 그분을 찾으면 그분을 만날 것이다. 그러나 네가 그분에게서 돌아서면 그분께서 너를 영원히 버리실 것이다.

pt.L: E tu, Salomão, meu filho, conhece o Deus do teu pai e serve-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} com coração íntegro e com alma disposta, porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} sonda todos os corações e entende toda intenção dos pensamentos. Se {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} buscares, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} será achado por ti; mas, se {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} abandonares, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} te rejeitará para sempre.
pt.B: Quanto a ti, meu filho Salomão, conhece o Deus do teu pai e serve-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} com o coração íntegro e com alma disposta, pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} sonda todos os corações e entende toda intenção por trás dos pensamentos. Se {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} buscares, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se deixará encontrar por ti; mas, se {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} abandonares, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} te rejeitará para sempre.
pt.R: E tu, Salomão, meu filho, procura conhecer o Deus a quem o teu pai serve. Serve-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} de todo o coração, com alegria e boa vontade. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} examina todos os corações, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} entende todos os planos e todos os pensamentos. Se {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} procurares, tu {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} encontrarás. Mas, se te afastares {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} te rejeitará para sempre.

decisions.choice: know the God of your father: know him personally and be loyal to him
decisions.reason: To "know" God is more than to know about him: it is to recognize him as one's own God, trust him and do what he wants (Jeremiah 22:16; Hosea 6:6). "The God of your father" is the God David has known and served (Genesis 26:24; 31:5).

decisions.choice: a complete heart and a willing soul: undivided loyalty given gladly
decisions.reason: A "complete" heart is whole and undivided, loyal without holding back, as in 12:39 and 29:9, 19. A "willing soul" serves with desire and delight, not by force. The two phrases together ask for the whole person.

decisions.choice: every intention of the thoughts: what people plan and purpose inside
decisions.reason: The first word means something formed or shaped, and so the purpose a person forms in the mind; Genesis 6:5 and 8:21 use it of the inclinations of the human heart. David prays in 29:18 that the LORD will keep such purposes in his people's hearts.

decisions.choice: if you seek him he will be found by you; if you forsake him he will reject you
decisions.reason: God lets himself be found by those who seek him, and he casts off those who leave him. The prophet Azariah says the same to King Asa (2 Chronicles 15:2), and Moses and Jeremiah promise it (Deuteronomy 4:29; Jeremiah 29:13-14). Solomon later turned from the LORD in his old age (1 Kings 11:4-11), though Chronicles does not tell that part of his story.

decisions.choice: a complete heart / an undivided heart / with all your heart
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use the same words as 12:39. Readable says "with all your heart, gladly and willingly" to explain both phrases (m2), and "look into" for "search".

decisions.choice: he will let you find him / you will find him
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "he will be found by you": God lets himself be found. Balanced keeps God as the one who acts; Readable says it from the seeker's side, which is the same in meaning.

decisions.choice: "toi" (singular) after "vous" in verse 8
decisions.reason: David turns from the assembly (plural in verse 8) to Solomon alone, and French marks it with "tu", as the meaning decision of verse 8 notes.

decisions.choice: David turns to Solomon in 해라체 with "내 아들 솔로몬아"
decisions.reason: As the parent-to-child address of the Genesis note and of 22:7.

decisions.choice: "온전한 마음"
decisions.reason: The same word as 12:39 in Korean for the "complete heart".

decisions.choice: tu (David's charge to Solomon, verses 9-10 and 20-21)
decisions.reason: David turns from the assembly to Solomon alone (m2 on verse 8) and gives him the charge with "tu", as 1 Kings 2:2-9 does in Portuguese for David's last charge to Solomon: the charge takes up the LORD's words to Joshua (verse 20), which Portuguese gives with "tu", and the solemn setting calls for it, where a father elsewhere says "você" to his son.

decisions.choice: com coração íntegro (L), com o coração íntegro (B); com alma disposta
decisions.reason: The words of 12:39 in Portuguese for the undivided heart (m2), as the English uses the words of that verse (r-en-1); "alma disposta" is the soul that serves gladly. The pronouns for God after the imperative and in the conditions take the span ("serve-o", "Se o buscares").

pt.B: Considera isto agora: {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} te escolheu para construir uma casa que seja o santuário. Sê forte e faz a obra."

decisions.choice: the sanctuary: the holy place where God dwells among his people
decisions.reason: The word means a holy place. It is used of the tabernacle, which God told Moses to make so that he could live among his people (Exodus 25:8).

decisions.choice: be strong and act: take courage and carry out the task
decisions.reason: The two commands together urge someone to stop holding back and get on with a task (Ezra 10:4). David will say it again, more fully, in verse 20.

decisions.choice: the LORD has chosen you
decisions.reason: This is the last link in the chain of the LORD's choices (verses 4-6). Solomon builds because God has chosen him to.

decisions.choice: act / do the work / get to work
decisions.reason: The verb "do" has no object. Literal keeps the bare "act"; Balanced and Readable say what is to be done, the work of building.

decisions.choice: Sê forte e age (L); Sê forte e faz a obra (B); Sê forte e começa o trabalho (R)
decisions.reason: "Sê forte" is the set opening of David's charge in 1 Kings 2:2 in Portuguese and of the charge to Joshua (m2); the bare verb "act" is "age" at Literal, and Balanced and Readable say what is to be done, as the English does (r-en-1).

records.literal_gloss: And gave David to Solomon his son [the] pattern of the porch and its houses and its treasuries and its upper rooms and its rooms the inner and [the] house of the mercy seat,

en.L: And David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch and of its houses and its treasuries and its upper rooms and its inner rooms and the house of the mercy seat,
en.B: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the porch of the temple, its buildings, its treasuries, its upper rooms, its inner rooms and the room for the mercy seat,
en.R: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the temple. They showed the porch at the front, the buildings, the storerooms for treasure, the upstairs rooms, the inner rooms, and the room for the gold lid of the ark, the place where sins are covered.

es.L: Y David dio a Salomón su hijo el modelo del pórtico y de sus edificios y de sus tesorerías y de sus aposentos altos y de sus cámaras interiores y de la casa del propiciatorio,
es.B: Luego David le dio a su hijo Salomón los planos del pórtico del templo, de sus edificios, sus tesorerías, sus aposentos altos, sus cuartos interiores y el cuarto del propiciatorio,
es.R: Luego David le dio a su hijo Salomón los planos del templo. Mostraban el pórtico de la entrada, los edificios, los cuartos para guardar los tesoros, los cuartos de arriba, los cuartos interiores y el cuarto donde estaba la tapa de oro del arca, el lugar donde se cubren los pecados.

fr.L: Et David donna à Salomon son fils le modèle du portique, et de ses maisons, et de ses trésors, et de ses chambres hautes, et de ses chambres intérieures, et de la maison du propitiatoire,

fr.R: Ensuite David a donné à son fils Salomon les plans du temple. On y voyait le portique d’entrée, les bâtiments, les salles du trésor, les pièces de l’étage, les pièces intérieures, et la salle du couvercle d’or de l’arche, l’endroit où les péchés sont couverts.
